# TiDB for AI

> TiDB is a distributed SQL database designed for modern AI applications, offering integrated vector search, full-text search, and hybrid search capabilities. This document provides an overview of the AI features and tools available for building AI-powered applications with TiDB.

## QUICK START

- [Get Started with Vector Search via Python](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/quickstart-via-python.md): Learn how to get started with vector search in TiDB using Python SDK.
- [Get Started with Vector Search via SQL](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/quickstart-via-sql.md): Learn how to quickly get started with Vector Search in TiDB using SQL statements to power your generative AI applications.
- [Get Started with TiDB Cloud CLI](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-quick-start.md): Install and configure TiDB Cloud CLI, then create and use a file system or manage and query a TiDB Cloud Starter database.

## GUIDES

- [Connect to TiDB via Python](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/connect.md): Learn how to connect to a TiDB database using the `pytidb` client.
- Search & Retrieval
  - Vector Search
    - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-overview.md): Learn about Vector Search in TiDB. This feature provides an advanced search solution for performing semantic similarity searches across various data types, including documents, images, audio, and video.
    - [Vector Search Guide](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search.md): Learn how to use vector search in your application.
    - [Vector Search Example](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-with-pytidb.md): Implement semantic search using vector embeddings to find similar content.
  - Full-Text Search
    - [Full-Text Search via Python](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-full-text-search-python.md): Full-text search lets you retrieve documents for exact keywords. In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) scenarios, you can use full-text search together with vector search to improve the retrieval quality.
    - [Full-Text Search via SQL](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-full-text-search-sql.md): Full-text search lets you retrieve documents for exact keywords. In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) scenarios, you can use full-text search together with vector search to improve the retrieval quality.
    - [Full-Text Search Example](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/fulltext-search-with-pytidb.md): Perform traditional text search using TiDB full-text search.
  - Hybrid Search
    - [Hybrid Search Guide](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-hybrid-search.md): Use full-text search and vector search together to improve the retrieval quality.
    - [Hybrid Search Example](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/hybrid-search-with-pytidb.md): Combine vector search and full-text search for more comprehensive results.
  - Auto Embeddings
    - [Auto Embedding Guide](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/auto-embedding.md): Learn how to use auto embedding in your application.
    - [Auto Embedding Example](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/auto-embedding-with-pytidb.md): Automatically generate embeddings for your text data using built-in embedding models.
  - Image Search
    - [Image Search Guide](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/image-search.md): Learn how to use image search in your application.
    - [Image Search Example](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/image-search-with-pytidb.md): Build an image search application using multimodal embeddings for both text-to-image and image-to-image search.
  - [Reranking](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/reranking.md): Learn how to use reranking in your application.
- Work with Data
  - [Work with Tables](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/tables.md): Learn how to work with tables in TiDB.
  - [Filtering](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/filtering.md): Learn how to use filtering in your application.
  - [Join Queries](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/join-queries.md): Learn how to use multiple table joins in your application.
  - [Raw SQL Queries](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/raw-queries.md): Learn how to use raw queries in your application.
  - [Transactions](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/transactions.md): Learn how to use transactions in your application.
- Build AI Applications
  - [RAG Example](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/rag-with-pytidb.md): Build a RAG application that combines document retrieval with language generation.
  - [Conversational Memory Example](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/memory-with-pytidb.md): Implement conversation memory for chatbots and conversational AI applications.
  - [Text-to-SQL Example](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/text2sql-with-pytidb.md): Convert natural language queries into SQL statements using AI models.
- TiDB Cloud CLI
  - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-overview.md): Learn when to use the TiDB Cloud CLI (`ti`) to manage TiDB Cloud Starter instances and file systems in TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
  - [Install, Configure, and Update TiDB Cloud CLI](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-install-configure-update.md): Install TiDB Cloud CLI releases, configure profiles, check versions, apply updates, and uninstall the CLI.
  - [Manage TiDB Cloud Starter Instances](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/manage-starter-instances.md): Learn how to use TiDB Cloud CLI to create and manage Starter instances, branches, SQL users, connections, and SQL statements.
  - [Manage TiDB Cloud Filesystem](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/manage-filesystems-via-cli.md): Learn how to create a file system and write and read a file with `ti fs`, then find guides for other file system tasks.
  - Scenarios for Users and Automation
    - [Run a Daily TiDB Cloud CLI Workflow](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-daily-workflow-example.md): Inspect resources, manage a TiDB Cloud Starter instance and file system, check for TiDB Cloud CLI updates, and clean up resources.
    - [Query TiDB Cloud Starter with Explicit SQL Roles](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-query-sql-with-roles-example.md): Prepare TiDB Cloud CLI-managed SQL users and run read-only, read-write, and admin statements with explicit privilege intent.
    - [Hand Off CI Artifacts Between Isolated Jobs with TiDB Cloud Filesystem](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-ci-artifact-handoff-example.md): Persist build output in TiDB Cloud Filesystem and consume it from a later CI job without copying a complete TiDB Cloud CLI profile.
  - Scenarios for AI Agents
    - [Use TiDB Cloud Filesystem in an Agent Sandbox](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-agent-sandbox-example.md): Provision a file system on a trusted machine and give a clean agent sandbox config-free access without TiDB Cloud API keys.
    - [Persist Agent State Across Disposable Sandboxes with TiDB Cloud Filesystem](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-persistent-agent-state-example.md): Preserve plans, checkpoints, outputs, and workflow history in a file system while replacing agent sandboxes.
    - [Share a Read-Only Dataset Across Parallel Agents with TiDB Cloud Filesystem](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-parallel-agent-dataset-example.md): Upload one unstructured dataset and expose the same read-only mounted namespace to multiple agent workers.
    - [Prepare a Git Workspace for Agents on TiDB Cloud Filesystem](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-git-workspace-for-agents-example.md): Make a large Git workspace visible quickly, hydrate clean objects in the background, and let an agent start work before the full download finishes.
    - [Record an Agent Workflow in a File System Journal](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-journal-agent-workflow-example.md): Create a journal, append structured agent events, search the workflow, and verify the journal hash chain.
    - [Delegate File System Vault Secrets to an Agent](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-vault-agent-secrets-example.md): Store a secret, grant one field to an agent, inject it into a process, audit access, and revoke the grant.
  - Command Reference
    - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-cli-reference.md): Reference TiDB Cloud CLI command groups, syntax, global options, output, dry-run behavior, help forms, and errors.
    - [configure](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-configure.md): Configure a local TiDB Cloud CLI profile interactively or non-interactively.
    - [update](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-update.md): Check for or install a TiDB Cloud CLI release update.
    - `ti db` Commands for Managing TiDB Cloud Starter Instances
      - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-starter-database.md): Reference every `ti db` command for Starter instances, branches, SQL users, connection strings, and SQL execution.
      - [create-db-cluster](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-create-db-cluster.md): Create a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
      - [list-db-clusters](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-list-db-clusters.md): List TiDB Cloud Starter clusters.
      - [describe-db-cluster](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-describe-db-cluster.md): Describe a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
      - [update-db-cluster](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-update-db-cluster.md): Update a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
      - [delete-db-cluster](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-delete-db-cluster.md): Delete a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
      - [create-db-cluster-branch](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-create-db-cluster-branch.md): Create a branch for a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
      - [list-db-cluster-branches](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-list-db-cluster-branches.md): List branches for a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
      - [describe-db-cluster-branch](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-describe-db-cluster-branch.md): Describe a branch for a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
      - [delete-db-cluster-branch](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-delete-db-cluster-branch.md): Delete a branch from a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
      - [create-db-sql-users](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-create-db-sql-users.md): Create TiDB Cloud CLI-managed SQL users for a TiDB Cloud Starter instance.
      - [format-db-connection-string](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-format-db-connection-string.md): Format a connection string for a TiDB Cloud CLI-managed SQL user.
      - [execute-sql-statement](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-db-execute-sql-statement.md): Execute one SQL statement against a TiDB Cloud Starter cluster.
    - `ti fs` Commands for Managing File Systems in TiDB Cloud Filesystem
      - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-filesystem.md): Reference every `ti fs` command for file system resources, files, layers, packs, and mounts.
      - [create-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-create-file-system.md): Create a file system.
      - [import-file-system-token](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-import-file-system-token.md): Import an existing file system token into the selected local profile.
      - [generate-file-system-token](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-generate-file-system-token.md): Generate an additional owner token for one TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
      - [generate-file-system-scoped-token](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-generate-file-system-scoped-token.md): Generate a path-and-operation-limited token for one TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
      - [list-file-system-tokens](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-list-file-system-tokens.md): List token metadata for one TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
      - [enable-file-system-token](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-enable-file-system-token.md): Enable a disabled file system token so it can authenticate again.
      - [disable-file-system-token](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-disable-file-system-token.md): Temporarily disable a file system token without deleting it.
      - [delete-file-system-token](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-delete-file-system-token.md): Permanently revoke a file system token so it can no longer authenticate.
      - [refresh-file-system-token](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-refresh-file-system-token.md): Rotate one file system token and return its replacement plaintext once.
      - [list-file-systems](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-list-file-systems.md): List remote file systems in a region.
      - [describe-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-describe-file-system.md): Describe a remote TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
      - [describe-file-system-extract-configuration](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-describe-file-system-extract-configuration.md): Describe media extraction configuration for a file system.
      - [update-file-system-extract-configuration](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-update-file-system-extract-configuration.md): Update media extraction configuration for a file system.
      - [describe-file-system-embedding-configuration](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-describe-file-system-embedding-configuration.md): Describe embedding configuration for a file system.
      - [update-file-system-embedding-configuration](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-update-file-system-embedding-configuration.md): Replace embedding configuration for a file system.
      - [check-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-check-file-system.md): Check TiDB Cloud Filesystem connectivity.
      - [delete-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-delete-file-system.md): Delete a file system.
      - [copy-file](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-copy-file.md): Copy files to, from, or within a file system.
      - [read-file](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-read-file.md): Read a file from a file system.
      - [list-files](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-list-files.md): List files in a file system.
      - [describe-file](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-describe-file.md): Describe a file in a file system.
      - [move-file](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-move-file.md): Move a file in a file system.
      - [delete-file](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-delete-file.md): Delete a file from a file system.
      - [create-directory](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-create-directory.md): Create a directory in a file system.
      - [chmod-file](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-chmod-file.md): Change file permissions in a file system.
      - [create-symlink](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-create-symlink.md): Create a symbolic link in a file system.
      - [create-hardlink](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-create-hardlink.md): Create a hard link in a file system.
      - [search-file-content](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-search-file-content.md): Search file content in a file system.
      - [find-files](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-find-files.md): Find files in a file system.
      - [create-layer](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-create-layer.md): Create a layer in a file system.
      - [list-layers](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-list-layers.md): List layers in a file system.
      - [fork-layer](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-fork-layer.md): Fork a copy-on-write child layer in a file system.
      - [list-layer-chain](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-list-layer-chain.md): List the ancestry chain for a file system layer.
      - [describe-layer](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-describe-layer.md): Describe a layer in a file system.
      - [diff-layer](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-diff-layer.md): Show changes in a file system layer.
      - [create-layer-checkpoint](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-create-layer-checkpoint.md): Create a checkpoint in a file system layer.
      - [delete-layer](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-delete-layer.md): Abandon a file system layer.
      - [rollback-layer](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-rollback-layer.md): Roll back a file system layer.
      - [commit-layer](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-commit-layer.md): Commit a file system layer.
      - [pack-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-pack-file-system.md): Pack local file system overlay state.
      - [unpack-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-unpack-file-system.md): Restore local file system overlay state.
      - [mount-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-mount-file-system.md): Mount a file system.
      - [drain-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-drain-file-system.md): Drain a mounted TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
      - [unmount-file-system](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-unmount-file-system.md): Unmount a file system.
    - `ti fs-git` Commands for Managing File System Git Workspaces
      - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-filesystem-git.md): Reference every `ti fs-git` command for cloning, hydrating, and managing linked Git worktrees.
      - [clone-git-workspace](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-git-clone-git-workspace.md): Clone a Git repository into a mounted TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
      - [hydrate-git-workspace](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-git-hydrate-git-workspace.md): Hydrate clean Git objects in a file system Git workspace.
      - [add-git-worktree](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-git-add-git-worktree.md): Add a linked Git worktree in a mounted TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
      - [remove-git-worktree](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-git-remove-git-worktree.md): Remove a linked Git worktree from a mounted TiDB Cloud Filesystem.
    - `ti fs-journal` Commands for Managing File System Journals
      - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-filesystem-journal.md): Reference every `ti fs-journal` command for creating, appending, reading, searching, and verifying journals.
      - [create-journal](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-journal-create-journal.md): Create an append-only file system journal.
      - [append-journal-entries](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-journal-append-journal-entries.md): Append entries to a file system journal.
      - [read-journal-entries](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-journal-read-journal-entries.md): Read entries from a file system journal.
      - [search-journal-entries](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-journal-search-journal-entries.md): Search file system journals and entries.
      - [verify-journal](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-journal-verify-journal.md): Verify a file system journal hash chain.
    - `ti fs-vault` Commands for Managing File System Vault Secrets
      - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-filesystem-vault.md): Reference every `ti fs-vault` command for secrets, delegated access, audit events, process injection, and mounts.
      - [create-secret](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-create-secret.md): Create a secret in file system Vault.
      - [replace-secret](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-replace-secret.md): Replace all fields in a file system Vault secret.
      - [read-secret](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-read-secret.md): Read a secret from file system Vault.
      - [list-secrets](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-list-secrets.md): List secrets visible to a file system Vault credential.
      - [delete-secret](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-delete-secret.md): Delete a secret from file system Vault.
      - [create-grant](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-create-grant.md): Create a delegated file system Vault grant.
      - [delete-grant](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-delete-grant.md): Revoke a delegated file system Vault grant.
      - [list-audit-events](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-list-audit-events.md): List file system Vault audit events.
      - [run-with-secret](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-run-with-secret.md): Run a process with a file system Vault secret.
      - [mount-vault](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-mount-vault.md): Mount a read-only file system Vault view.
      - [unmount-vault](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-fs-vault-unmount-vault.md): Unmount a file system Vault view.
  - [TiDB Cloud CLI Configuration and Credentials](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-configuration-and-credentials.md): Reference TiDB Cloud CLI profiles, precedence rules, local state paths, file system credentials, SQL credentials, mount locators, and operation logs.
  - [TiDB Cloud CLI Regions, Security, and Limitations](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-regions-security-and-limitations.md): Reference supported regions, authentication boundaries, security best practices, and current TiDB Cloud CLI limitations.
  - [Migrate from tdc to TiDB Cloud CLI](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-migrate-from-tdc.md): Migrate supported local state and automation from tdc v0.1.x to TiDB Cloud CLI.
  - [Troubleshoot TiDB Cloud CLI](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/ti-troubleshooting.md): Learn how to diagnose TiDB Cloud CLI API authentication, Starter quota, SQL credential, and interrupted-command failures safely.

## INTEGRATIONS

- [Integration Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-integration-overview.md): An overview of AI integrations for TiDB, including Auto Embedding providers, AI frameworks, ORM libraries, cloud services, and MCP server support.
- Auto Embedding
  - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-auto-embedding-overview.md): Learn how to use Auto Embedding to perform semantic searches with plain text instead of vectors.
  - [OpenAI](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-auto-embedding-openai.md): Learn how to use OpenAI embedding models in TiDB Cloud.
  - [OpenAI Compatible](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/embedding-openai-compatible.md): Learn how to integrate TiDB Vector Search with an OpenAI-compatible embedding model to store embeddings and perform semantic search.
  - [Jina AI](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-auto-embedding-jina-ai.md): Learn how to use Jina AI embedding models in TiDB Cloud.
  - [Cohere](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-auto-embedding-cohere.md): Learn how to use Cohere embedding models in TiDB Cloud.
  - [Google Gemini](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-auto-embedding-gemini.md): Learn how to use Google Gemini embedding models in TiDB Cloud.
  - [Hugging Face](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-auto-embedding-huggingface.md): Learn how to use Hugging Face embedding models in TiDB Cloud.
  - [NVIDIA NIM](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-auto-embedding-nvidia-nim.md): Learn how to use NVIDIA NIM embedding models in TiDB Cloud.
  - [Amazon Titan](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-auto-embedding-amazon-titan.md): Learn how to use Amazon Titan embedding models in TiDB Cloud.
- AI Frameworks
  - [LlamaIndex](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-integrate-with-llamaindex.md): Learn how to integrate TiDB Vector Search with LlamaIndex.
- ORM Libraries
  - [SQLAlchemy](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-integrate-with-sqlalchemy.md): Learn how to integrate TiDB Vector Search with SQLAlchemy to store embeddings and perform semantic searches.
  - [Django ORM](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-integrate-with-django-orm.md): Learn how to integrate TiDB Vector Search with Django ORM to store embeddings and perform semantic search.
  - [Peewee](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-integrate-with-peewee.md): Learn how to integrate TiDB Vector Search with peewee to store embeddings and perform semantic searches.
- Cloud Services
  - [Jina AI Embedding](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-integrate-with-jinaai-embedding.md): Learn how to integrate TiDB Vector Search with Jina AI Embeddings API to store embeddings and perform semantic search.
  - [Amazon Bedrock](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/vector-search-integrate-with-amazon-bedrock.md): Learn how to integrate TiDB Vector Search with Amazon Bedrock to build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Q&A bot.
- MCP Server
  - [Overview](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/tidb-mcp-server.md): Manage your TiDB databases using natural language instructions with the TiDB MCP Server.
  - [Claude Code](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/tidb-mcp-claude-code.md): This guide shows you how to configure the TiDB MCP Server in Claude Code.
  - [Claude Desktop](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/tidb-mcp-claude-desktop.md): This guide shows you how to configure the TiDB MCP Server in Claude Desktop.
  - [Cursor](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/tidb-mcp-cursor.md): This guide shows you how to configure the TiDB MCP Server in the Cursor editor.
  - [VS Code](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/tidb-mcp-vscode.md): This guide shows you how to configure the TiDB MCP Server in Visual Studio Code.
  - [Windsurf](https://docs.pingcap.com/ai/tidb-mcp-windsurf.md): This guide shows you how to configure the TiDB MCP Server in Windsurf.
